purpose: Record the Ghidra-derived ordering contract for W1 normal-enemy primary callbacks and the player callback.

source.pipeline: research/tools/run_player_external_closure.py; Ghidra-only raw NE segment import, listing, and decompiler exports

static_chain.name: are_object_factory
static_chain.inputs_outputs: Allocates the first-free 0x78-byte object and initializes +0x18 from AX, +0x1C=0x1997, +0x28=1, +0x17=1, +0x12=0xffff, +0x1A=0xffff, +0x14=0.
static_chain.return_flags: ES:DI publishes the object; allocator failure enters the existing fatal path; no gameplay callback consumes flags

static_chain.name: biene_initializer_and_orientation_wrappers
static_chain.inputs_outputs: Far ES:DI object; installs primary callback 01F7:68C0, seeds W1 BIENE state, and selects orientation/velocity by wrapper.

static_chain.name: wurm2_initializer_and_orientation_wrappers
static_chain.inputs_outputs: Far ES:DI object; installs primary callback 01F7:6DC4, seeds W1 WURM2 state, and selects orientation/velocity by wrapper.

static_chain.name: register_object_scheduler_entry
static_chain.inputs_outputs: Far ES:DI object; appends +0x18 to the current bank entry +0x00, +0x1C to +0x02, and the object offset to +0x04, then advances DS:7966 by eight bytes.
static_chain.return_flags: preserves the caller's AX/DX pair; no scheduler flags are consumed

static_chain.name: object_update_pass_by_phase
static_chain.inputs_outputs: Walks the selected scheduler bank three times, invoking entry +0x00 for object phase 0, then 1, then 2; increments DS:88C8 after each callback.
static_chain.return_flags: primary callback return flags are not consumed by the pass

static_chain.name: update_player_3FF8
static_chain.inputs_outputs: Far ES:DI player object; phase-2 primary callback in the same 0E96 pass.
player_global_writes: complete player callback record and its recovered globals
object_writes: player +0x00..+0x77 as recovered by the callback closure
static_chain.return_flags: near/far callback return is handled by the scheduler wrapper; no phase ordering flags consumed

static_chain.name: object_update_pass_nonzero_state
static_chain.inputs_outputs: Later pass invokes scheduler entry +0x02 secondary callbacks, independent of the +0x18 primary callback phase.
static_chain.return_flags: secondary callback return flags are not consumed
static_chain.scheduler_position: after 0E96; not the dispatch point for W1 68C0/6DC4 primary callbacks

conclusion.native_change: Dispatch the implemented W1 normal-enemy callbacks before Simulation::tick() and record them as GameplayObjectBeforePlayer.
conclusion.scope: This closes ordering for the implemented W1 primary callbacks only. It does not claim that every pooled object family is implemented or that secondary presentation callbacks affect player simulation.
remaining_runtime_questions: natural enemy/player contact timing in additional W1 routes
secondary callbacks that can feed gameplay outside the closed W1 paths
